## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue (`Closes #…`).

## Verification

List checks actually run, the platform, and any unverified behavior. Distinguish
synthetic fixtures from live-game checks. Do not attach private captures or credentials.

## Checklist

- [ ] Within the fair-play boundary (no game input, modification or hidden information)
- [ ] Works on Windows and Linux, or the gap is in the README table and `docs/status.md`
- [ ] Checks from CONTRIBUTING for every area touched
- [ ] User-visible change noted in `CHANGELOG.md` under _Unreleased_; guides updated
- [ ] No tokens, personal data, captures or proprietary files
